mapper.select: SELECT d.id AS dept_id, d.dept_code, d.dept_name, d.status, d.parent_id FROM sys_post p LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = p.dept_id AND d.is_deleted = 0 WHERE p.id = #{postId} AND p.is_deleted = 0

SELECT up.user_id, u.username, u.nickname, u.employee_no, u.status AS user_status, up.is_primary, up.status AS relation_status, up.create_time, up.update_time FROM user_post up INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = up.user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 WHERE up.post_id = #{postId} AND up.status IN (1, 2) ORDER BY up.is_primary DESC, up.create_time DESC, u.username
